pages.text: $(l)Multimeter$()$(br)Hold it in either hand and look at an electric block to read its $(item)voltage$(), $(item)current$(), $(item)resistance$() and $(item)power$(). Generators also show the voltage and power they produce. Sneak to add the network's total generation and consumption. Craft it with dye to change its color.

$(l)Electric Gauge Place it against an electric block:$() its needle reads the block behind it. Use a Create $(item)wrench$() on it to cycle the mode and scale: voltage (500 V), high voltage (10,000 V), current (16 A), resistance (500 ohms), power (5,000 W), network usage and generation (50,000 W) and accumulator charge. It is also a $(item)display link$() source.

$(l)Configuration Wrench$()$(br)Sneak and right-click to open a screen and choose a $(item)group$() number stored on the wrench. In this version groups do not change how a network is computed: every consumer stays in parallel.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
